verdict.rationale: Galileo ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants create/manage datasets, run experiments, and set up prompt templates from a dev environment using natural language, and it supports continuous natural-language feedback to refine metrics — both are concrete NL-driven operation paths. However, there's no evidence of a native chat/NL command interface within the Galileo console itself; missing for 10: first-party in-app NL command console, broader coverage of all product actions via NL, and independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP NL workflow.
